source.quote: xDuoo's own page for the MU-601 on its English site, read 2026-11-25. Hero chip row: « ES9018K2M PCM 384kHz DSD256 UAC 1.0 / 2.0 ». Technical Data: « Input Interface  USB audio with UAC 1.0 and UAC 2.0 modes »; « Headphone Output  Coaxial and AUX outputs »; « Sampling Rate  PCM 384kHz / DSD256 ». Key Features: « USB audio reaches PCM 32-bit/384kHz. » « USB playback supports DSD up to DSD256. » « Two USB modes broaden source compatibility. ». No digital filter is NAMED, no oversampling bypass and no non-oversampling mode is mentioned, and DoP is not mentioned - across this maker's whole catalogue DoP appears on one page only, the LINK10.

_la_source_est_le_site_ANGLAIS_dont_les_: Every xDuoo record is sourced to xduoo.net, whose /terms page was read in full on 2026-11-25 and forbids nothing beyond misuse of the site itself: « Do not misuse the website, interfere with its operation or attempt unauthorized access to website or customer information. » The maker's Chinese site, xduoo.com, publishes no terms page at all AND publishes every specification as a JPEG image, so nothing is taken from it. See the brand file for both findings in full.
_pourquoi_native_dsd_nest_PAS_ecrit_ici: The page carries a sentence of the form « DSD512 support enables native high-resolution music playback », and so do more than twenty other xduoo.net pages, word for word, including a passive R2R module and a portable player. It is generated template text. A claim made identically about twenty different products is a claim about none of them, so `native_dsd` is absent on every xDuoo record despite the word appearing on nearly all of them.
_le_coaxial_de_cet_appareil_est_une_SORT: « Headphone Output  Coaxial and AUX outputs ». The word coaxial appears on this page under the output row, and the only input is USB. A harvester searching for « coaxial » would have given this device an S/PDIF input it does not have - and this maker labels EVERY output row « Headphone Output », digital outputs included, so the trap is systematic rather than accidental.
